scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,app "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:voice: npm run build && concurrently -n worker,app,voice "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:app" "node scripts/voice-tunnel.mjs"
scripts.preview:base: export BCA_BASE_PATH=/hiring-agent && npm run build && node scripts/preview-config.mjs && wrangler dev --port 8790 -c wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.migrate:local: for f in ./migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute bca-db --local --file=$f; done
scripts.deploy: node scripts/production-config.mjs && npm run build && wrangler deploy --minify -c wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: node scripts/production-config.mjs && for f in ./migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute bca-db --remote -y -c wrangler.production.jsonc --file=$f; done
